title: SLC24A5 light-skin variant: oldest known carrier
summary: The oldest known carrier of the light-skin SLC24A5 variant lived about 13,000 years ago in Georgia. The variant may have arisen as early as 19,000 years ago and later spread widely in Europe.
why: Skin colour changed recently, long after people reached Europe.

notes.problem: Title 'appears' claims an origin date; source gives only the earliest known sample (13,000 y) and says it was 'possibly originating as long as 19,000 years ago'.
